content.comment_body: Hello, I need support for a new project. I want to measure oven temperature with a PT100 sensor, with a setpoint range of 30 to 250°C. In this range, I also need to control a servo valve using a 4-20mA output: 20mA at 30°C, 4mA at 250°C, proportionally adjusting the fuel flow as the temperature setpoint is reached. The system should minimize fluctuations and also manage a burner via digital output. Thanks in advance for your help.
Can you let us know which PLC you plan to use?
Good morning, I apologize for omitting an important detail: I am using a [product_name] with its RTD modules for PT100 and a 4-20mA analog output module.

The AM2 RTD module for PT100/1000 has a fixed temperature measurement range from -50°C to 200°C. For measurements up to 250°C or above, you need an external PT converter with a 0-10V or 0/4-20mA output and an AM2 analog input module.
Understood. With the AM2 module connected to the PT100, I would appreciate advice on how to perform proportional regulation as described earlier.
So you'd use the AM2 and an external PT converter with a 0-10V or 0/4-20mA signal to match your required temperature scale?

That's right. With the external PT, I will connect it to the AM2 RTD module to obtain the process temperature, and simultaneously control the valve opening proportionally via 4-20mA using the AM2 AQ output module.

Let me clarify again: If you use AM2 RTD, you'll only be able to read temperatures from -50°C to 200°C, as this is a fixed range for the module. For temperature readings above 200°C, you need an external PT converter with either 0-10V or 0/4-20mA output, and switch to the analog AM2 input module instead of AM2 RTD.

Thanks, I see that with the AM2 RTD modules, I can record up to 200°C, and with the 0-10V/4-20mA analog input module, I can take measurements above 200°C. Could you provide a reference program for this setup?
Thanks a lot. I tested the simulation and it works well. I'll do further testing with the actual hardware and will update you on the results. I appreciate your help.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is working on oven temperature regulation using [product_name], RTD, and analog I/O modules, but faces confusion over hardware limits for temperature readings above 200°C. Repeated clarifications focus on the fixed range limitation of the RTD module and required configurations for PT100 sensors and proportional analog control above 200°C.
analysis.user_expectations: User wants to reliably measure and control temperatures from 30 to 250°C with [product_name] modules, and requests clear guidance regarding suitable hardware and example programming to achieve proportional analog output.
